soft_issues: Several survey bar charts are images, so some Likert category counts are incomplete in the extract.

claim_checks.claim: Area collaboration is defined as cooperation between two or more aquaculture firms in a defined sea area. The main finding is that it should as far as possible be voluntary.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Et hovedfunn er at områdesamarbeid i norsk havbruk bør i størst mulig graf være frivillig.
claim_checks.note: Cover summary has a typo (graf for grad). Methods 2.1 restrict the object to næringsaktører.

claim_checks.claim: The 2018 mapping used 37 informants from industry, authorities and organisations. It found voluntary, mandated, and voluntary-under-compulsion forms.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Denne kartleggingen var basert på spørreundersøkelse/intervju med 37 informanter fra havbruk, forvaltning og næringslivsorganisasjoner
claim_checks.note: This N=37 is not the same sample as the 2019 farmer survey.

claim_checks.claim: The 2019 Norstat survey of 37 farmers found extensive neighbour cooperation. About two thirds also cooperate with authorities beyond mandatory requirements. Twenty-eight of 37 cooperate to cut disease and parasite risk.
claim_checks.extract_quote: cirka 2/3 samarbeider med forvaltningen utenom hva som anses som lovpålagte krav
claim_checks.note: Twenty-eight of 37 is stated in section 4.1.4.

claim_checks.claim: Twenty-three of 37 agreed that increased competition for sites limits operational and preparedness cooperation. Conflicts rise with density and many firms.
claim_checks.extract_quote: 23 av informantene er helt og delvis enige i at økt konkurranse om lokaliteter begrenser samarbeidet om drift og beredskap
claim_checks.note: Eight disagreed. A Food Safety Authority informant named area access as the main barrier.

claim_checks.claim: Twenty-five informants said the Food Safety Authority requires coordinated fallowing when approving operating plans. About half did not treat coordinated delousing as central.
claim_checks.extract_quote: 25 informanter mener at Mattilsynet krever koordinerte brakkleggingssoner ved godkjenning av driftsplanene

claim_checks.claim: The 2019 algae bloom is used to show limits of site-level preparedness. A companion report is cited for about 13 400 tonnes and about 8 million fish lost among 14 farmers.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Under denne krisen tapte oppdretterne cirka 13 400 tonn fisk (6 600 tonn i Nordland og
claim_checks.note: Figures are cited from Karlsen et al. 2019 and the Directorate of Fisheries, not newly counted in this report.

claim_checks.claim: Guarracino et al. 2018 raise doubt that joint fallowing affects lice. The authors call for scientific clarification. The June 2019 fallowing map is a snapshot.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Funn fra Veterinærinstituttet sår tvil om felles brakklegging har effekt på lusesituasjonen (Guarracino et al., 2018).

claim_checks.claim: Recommendations include voluntary collaboration, clearer contracts with sanctions, well-boat rules, conflict handling, emergency sites per production area, and digital tools.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Områdesamarbeidet i norsk havbruk bør i størst mulig grad være frivillig.
claim_checks.note: Emergency sites are recommendation 6. Ostrom conditions are in chapter 3 and recommendation 3.

evidence_direction_note: not_applicable is correct. The report maps collaboration forms and recommends voluntary organisation. It does not test a stated causal siting effect.
priority_questions_note: A3 (firm-to-firm trade-offs, site competition, externalities) and A5 (density, fallowing, lice, emergency sites). A1 not tagged. Municipal sea planning is background.
coi_note: FHF 901391 funding is stated. NSD approval is stated. No competing-interest statement. coi_declared remains unclear.
